summary: Phase S2 acceptance passes. All 209 protected-source curriculum activities are bound to the reviewed Codecamp graph with strict exposure and assessed-evidence semantics, exact source inventory coverage, content-addressed provenance, and fail-closed mastery projection.
evidence: The authoritative snapshot contains 19 published modules, 88 lessons, 85 questions, 16 guided exercises, 16 tutorial repositories, and 4 portfolio reviews.
The binding release contains 209 activities: 88 exposure-only lessons and 121 assessed question, exercise, pull-request, and portfolio activities.

Release validation joins the reviewed graph, exact source inventory, and separate content-addressed provenance manifest; it rejects source totals/module drift, unknown source activities, rubric applicability errors, incompatible resources, and incomplete evidence.
Mastery projection accepts only the runtime release object returned by successful validation, preventing schema-only or invalid bindings from emitting evidence.
